mo-yard.html: Morgan–Owens has front and back the wrong way round, giving ārea anterior for the back yard (s.v. yard: backyard).

sources: Lewis & Short: posticus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. yard, yard: backyard, lawn, lawn: lawn-mower, lawn: mow the lawn, sprinkler, hoe. John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 38, 39, 320, 409.
